examples.description: Pull approved prepared outputs for local delivery

preconditions: Returns APPROVED outputs only — approval happens in the platform inbox.

description: List this tenant's APPROVED prepared outputs: drafts a workflow's prepare_output nodes parked for review, which a human then approved in the platform inbox. Pending and rejected drafts never appear here — approval happens only in the inbox, never through this call. Optional limit 1-100 (default 50), newest-decided first. This is the platform-prepares-never-sends handoff: the desktop harness pulls approved drafts here and sends them locally.

limit.description: Max rows to return, 1-100 (default 50). Out-of-range or non-integer values fall back to 50.

name: workflow_prepared_outputs
